Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429 across inference endpoints — urgent

Short update from infra/ops: we’re seeing a client-side SDK change (deployed by a BrightCart partner last night) that altered retry backoff behavior — effectively reducing jitter and increasing concurrent retries on client failure. That caused a surge in simultaneous connections to the recommendation endpoint. Our autoscaler responded but queueing/backpressure led to elevated latencies and 5xx responses once workers saturated.

Mitigations applied (10:05 UTC):
- Enabled short-term request-shed policy for the recommendation route to protect core checkout flows (reduces non-critical calls by ~70%).
- Scoped a temporary rate limit on anonymous ingestion from mobile SDKs.
- Rolled out a fallback route to the L2 model variant for at-risk traffic.

Preliminary numbers: error rate down from 18% -> 2.3% after mitigations, but we still see pockets of timeout recovery.

Proposed customer credit: we recommend offering BrightCart a 10% service credit for the impacted billing period (window: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z to 2026-03-25T08:30:00Z). Attached: incident_timeline.pdf, error-rate-graph.png.

If sales/finance want to be more generous (12% or a trial of Dedicated capacity), let me know and I can approve the change with leadership sign-off.

— Rishi
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
